title: The Hurt Locker
desc: THE HURT LOCKER is an intense portrayal of elite soldiers who have one of the most dangerous jobs in the world: disarming bombs during the Iraq War.

title: Follow Me
desc: The line between real life and social media is blurred. A social media star, influencer and his passion to capture new content for his successful VLOG, travels to Moscow with his friends, enters a deadly-life game filled with mystery and danger. Always pushing the limits and catering to a growing audience, the group must fight to escape, and survive with unexpected deadly consequences.

title: Rememory
desc: You can’t escape them. They’re everywhere. They bring tears to our eyes. They make us laugh. They bring us pain. Gordon a visionary inventor of the Rememory machine that allows him to see memories. He dies in his office. Is it murder? Sam investigates by using the machine "borrowed" from Gordon's wife. He looks at memories of others involved. REMEMORY is a noir mystery Thriller.
